create_trajectory_frame_from_atoms: create a TrajectoryFrame from an ASE Atoms object with step number and optional simulation time
convert_trajectory_frame_to_dict: convert a TrajectoryFrame dataclass instance to a dictionary for Parquet serialization with all fields
write_trajectory_to_parquet: write molecular dynamics trajectory frames to a Parquet file using ParquetTrajectoryWriter with buffered writes
append_frame_to_parquet_writer: append a TrajectoryFrame to a ParquetTrajectoryWriter buffer and auto flush when interval is reached
use_parquet_writer_as_context_manager: use ParquetTrajectoryWriter as a context manager to automatically flush and close the Parquet file on exit
